 import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

data = {
    'Stage': [
        'Job Seekers', 'CVs Submitted', 'Initial Interviews', 'Technical Assessments',

        'Retained (6 Months)', 'Retained (1 Year)'

    'Windhoek Urban Men 18-25': [1000, 800, 480, 330, 210, 95, 75, 70, 65, 60],
    'Windhoek Urban Women 26-35': [1000, 780, 520, 380, 230, 105, 85, 80, 75, 70],
    'Windhoek Urban Men 26-35': [1000, 820, 550, 420, 260, 125, 100, 95, 90, 85],
    'Oshakati Urban Women 18-25': [1000, 650, 350, 200, 120, 45, 35, 30, 25, 20],
    'Oshakati Urban Men 18-25': [1000, 700, 380, 230, 140, 60, 45, 40, 35, 32],
    'Opuwo Rural Women 18-25': [1000, 500, 200, 80, 30, 15, 10, 8, 6, 5],
    'Opuwo Rural Men 18-25': [1000, 550, 220, 100, 45, 20, 15, 12, 10, 8],
    'Rundu Urban Women 26-35': [1000, 720, 400, 250, 150, 65, 50, 45, 40, 38],
    'Rundu Urban Men 26-35': [1000, 760, 450, 300, 180, 85, 65, 60, 55, 52],
    'Katima Mulilo Urban Women 18-25': [1000, 680, 380, 220, 125, 55, 40, 35, 30, 28],
    'Katima Mulilo Urban Men 18-25': [1000, 710, 420, 250, 150, 70, 50, 45, 42, 40]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

colors = [
    '#1f77b4', '#ff7f0e', '#2ca02c', '#d62728',
    '#9467bd', '#8c564b', '#e377c2', '#7f7f7f',
    '#bcbd22', '#17becf', '#aec7e8', '#ffbb78'
]

for i, demographic in enumerate(df.columns[1:].drop('Opuwo Rural Women 18-25')):
    plt.plot(df['Stage'], df[demographic], marker='o', label=demographic, color=colors[i])

plt.title('Employment Pipeline Progression by Demographic Group in Namibian Regions', pad=20)
plt.xlabel('Employment Stage', labelpad=10)
plt.ylabel('Average Time in Stage (Days)', labelpad=10)
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
plt.legend(bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')

SUMMARY
 The image is a line chart titled "Employment Pipeline Progression by Demographic Group in Namibian Regions," which illustrates the number of individuals progressing through various stages of the employment process across different demographic groups. The x-axis represents the employment stages, starting from "Job Seekers" and moving through subsequent phases such as "CVs Submitted," "Initial Interviews," "Technical Assessments," "Final Interviews," "Job Offers," "Hired," and retention milestones at three months, six months, and one year. The y-axis indicates the number of individuals, ranging from 0 to 1000.

Twelve distinct lines, each in a different color, represent various demographic groups categorized by region, gender, and age. The chart shows a clear downward trend for all groups as they move through the employment stages, reflecting a gradual reduction in the number of individuals remaining in the pipeline.

At the "Job Seekers" stage, all groups start at 1000 individuals. By the "CVs Submitted" stage, the numbers drop, with the Opuwo Rural Women 18-25 group experiencing the largest decline to 500 individuals, while Windhoek Urban Men 26-35 maintain the highest number at 820 individuals. This pattern continues with noticeable drops at each subsequent stage. For instance, after "Initial Interviews," the Opuwo Rural Women 18-25 group further declines to 200, whereas Windhoek Urban Men 26-35 reduce to 550 individuals.

By the "Hired" stage, the number of individuals across all groups significantly decreases, with the Opuwo Rural Women 18-25 group having the lowest at 10 individuals and Windhoek Urban Men 26-35 the highest at 100 individuals. The retention stages show minimal further reductions, indicating stability among those who have secured employment. At the one-year retention mark, the numbers are relatively low across all groups, with Windhoek Urban Men 26-35 retaining the highest at 85 individuals and Opuwo Rural Women 18-25 the lowest at 5 individuals.

The chart effectively highlights disparities in employment progression among different demographic groups in Namibian regions, illustrating how various factors such as region, gender, and age may influence employment outcomes.
